lease.fixtures: Only the two named routine-production-catalog fixtures
lease.root_owned_surfaces: Cargo manifests, Cargo.lock, public catalog/dispatcher, grants, migration registry, generated authority, claims, release and acceptance records are forbidden
lease.external_effects: Only locked and offline Cargo builds/tests in isolated /private/tmp roots are authorized

required_behavior: Use one canonical case identity consistently for symbolic tool equality and authority lookup.
Reject primary/fallback tools that differ only by case before catalog adoption.
Reject cross-definition case aliases carrying different authorities.
Permit intentional repeated use only when canonical symbolic identity and complete executable authority are identical.
Retain the exact executable-path, content, length, and mode binding already established by R1.
required_validation: case-alias same-authority behavior explicitly adopted and tested
path, content, length, mode, catalog, and observation drift controls
focused suite twice, dependency-closed routine suite, production library check, zero-hidden-write comparison, and authoritative WorkerResult-v1 validation with 16 jobs and threads
worker_result_requirements: Freeze exact regular single-link artifact rows, aggregate, bytes, final root binding, commands/outcomes, effects, requested root changes, unsupported claims, and exact no-claim statement.
stop_rule: Stop on any shared/root-only change, widened effect, ambiguous canonical identity, regression in executable binding, or inability to prove read-only paths have zero hidden writes.
no_claim_statement: This corrective work package does not claim source acceptance, public execution, installation, runtime behavior, node closure, readiness, release, or completion.
